population: the first 100 settled LIVE OFFICIAL (T24) snapshots of edgedesk_cfb_p4_v1.0.0 taken at or after 2026-09-28T00:00:00.000Z
rule: Do not change the model to hit any number below. Do not retrofit: a bug fix is a declared patch (versions.jsonl) and no historical prediction is altered. At 100 settled games the current champion is compared with the legacy system on these same definitions.

metrics.label: market moved toward EdgeDesk (% of moved lines)
false-major-disagreement rate (% of VERIFIED that were false extremes)
decision selectivity (% of games with a qualified wager)

margin_mae.source: LEGACY view: the champion’s reconstructed 2026 numbers, last pre-kickoff per game (Model Lab GIT_RECONSTRUCTED)

margin_mae_backtest_2022_2025.source: walk-forward 2022–2025, spread MAE of the published fair (EDCfbP4Params.validation_summary.market)

interval_coverage_80.source: LEGACY view — the reconstructed rows published no intervals, so there is no legacy coverage baseline

false_major_rate.source: integrity gate replayed on the 2022–2025 holdout (forensics_cfb.json gate_backtest.holdout_football_only)

decision_selectivity.source: betting disabled by the frozen decision policy: no qualified wager exists in the legacy record
